security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Offline dice to BIP-39 seed phrase
bundle.longDescription: Converts a log of six-sided dice rolls into a BIP-39 seed phrase, offline, as a second implementation to check a hardware wallet against.
